planescape.rule.sigil-extradimensional-s.blocked_reason: The rule requires representing a space within another space and applying local restrictions to it.

planescape.rule.sigil-interplanar-travel.name: Sigil interplanar-travel restriction

effect.summary: Effects attempting to enter or leave Sigil by interplanar travel fail, except for the stated circle exception.

planescape.rule.sigil-interplanar-travel.cost_or_limit: Teleportation-circle access is an exception described in the passage.
planescape.rule.sigil-interplanar-travel.who_may: Applies to interplanar travel effects used to enter or leave Sigil.
planescape.rule.sigil-interplanar-travel.blocked_reason: The restriction overrides the operation of otherwise functioning travel effects.

planescape.rule.sigil-summoning-restrict.name: Sigil summoning restriction

effect.summary: Summoning from other planes draws a target from Sigil if possible; otherwise it fails, and summoning a specified outsider fails automatically.

planescape.rule.sigil-summoning-restrict.cost_or_limit: Specific targets outside Sigil cannot be summoned.
planescape.rule.sigil-summoning-restrict.who_may: Applies to spells, items, and other summoning effects in Sigil.
planescape.rule.sigil-summoning-restrict.combines: Examples include ring of djinni summoning and Leomund’s secret chest.
planescape.rule.sigil-summoning-restrict.blocked_reason: The rule changes the source and success conditions of summoning effects.

planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-rest.name: Sigil teleportation restriction

effect.summary: Teleporting into or out of Sigil fails, while teleportation within the city functions normally.

planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-rest.cost_or_limit: The restriction applies only to travel across the city boundary.
planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-rest.who_may: Applies to teleportation effects used in Sigil.
planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-rest.combines: Permanent teleportation circles have a separate rule.
planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-rest.blocked_reason: The rule distinguishes interboundary travel from teleportation within Sigil.

planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-circ.name: Sigil teleportation-circle restriction

effect.summary: Existing permanent circles can be used by permitted travelers to enter Sigil via plane shift, but not to leave, and new circles cannot be made.

planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-circ.cost_or_limit: Permission is needed to use existing circles to enter.
planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-circ.who_may: Travelers with permission may enter by the stated means.
planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-circ.combines: The Lady of Pain controls the city’s portals and circles.
planescape.rule.sigil-teleportation-circ.blocked_reason: The restriction modifies creation and direction of an established travel effect.

planescape.rule.portal-activation.name: Portal activation

effect.summary: A portal opens at its set time, on a condition or command, or when a traveler carries its key; a keyed crossing keeps it open until that traveler’s next turn.

planescape.rule.portal-activation.cost_or_limit: Most portals are not continuously open.
planescape.rule.portal-activation.who_may: A creature carrying the relevant key can trigger keyed portals.
planescape.rule.portal-activation.combines: Keys may work from either side.

planescape.rule.portal-detection.name: Portal detection

effect.summary: Inactive portals are usually invisible and evade detect magic, but true seeing or warp sense can reveal them; active portals usually glow and show their destination.

planescape.rule.portal-detection.cost_or_limit: Detection depends on the portal’s state and the spell used.
planescape.rule.portal-detection.who_may: Creatures using the specified detection magic.
planescape.rule.portal-detection.blocked_reason: The rule relies on specific detection capabilities and differing detection outcomes.

planescape.rule.one-way-portal.name: One-Way portal

effect.summary: Allows travel in only one direction and cannot be seen or detected from its exit side.

planescape.rule.one-way-portal.cost_or_limit: Travel works only into or out of Sigil, in one direction.

planescape.rule.shifting-portal.name: Shifting portal

effect.summary: One portal endpoint moves among locations in Sigil or the destination plane.

planescape.rule.shifting-portal.cost_or_limit: The endpoint changes location in a pattern.

planescape.rule.slow-portal.name: Slow portal

effect.summary: A traveler arrives 2d4 days after entering, spending the interval in unaware stasis.

planescape.rule.slow-portal.mind: The traveler is unaware of the time passing.
planescape.rule.slow-portal.blocked_reason: The traveler experiences a suspended, unaware interval before arrival.

planescape.rule.taxing-portal.name: Taxing portal

effect.summary: A traveler must save or gain one level of exhaustion after crossing.

planescape.rule.taxing-portal.cost_or_limit: DC 10 Constitution save avoids the exhaustion.

planescape.rule.temporary-portal.name: Temporary portal

effect.summary: The portal vanishes after allowing 1d6 + 6 travelers through in either direction.

planescape.rule.temporary-portal.go_wrong: The portal disappears when its capacity is reached.

planescape.rule.tumbling-lock.name: Tumbling Lock

effect.summary: Each opening requires a different portal key.

planescape.rule.tumbling-lock.cost_or_limit: The key changes on every opening.
planescape.rule.tumbling-lock.go_wrong: A previously used key no longer suffices.
planescape.rule.tumbling-lock.who_may: Travelers seeking to open the portal.
planescape.rule.tumbling-lock.blocked_reason: The portal’s required key changes with each use.

planescape.rule.gifts-to-the-ring-givers.name: Gifts to the Ring Givers return tenfold

effect.summary: A common belief says a gift to the faction comes back to its giver multiplied by ten.

planescape.rule.recording-and-reliving-s.name: Recording and reliving sensory experiences

effect.summary: Sensory stones let creatures preserve and later relive another's sensory experience.

planescape.rule.recording-and-reliving-s.cost_or_limit: Complex or lengthy experiences cost more to access
planescape.rule.recording-and-reliving-s.go_wrong: Restricted experiences may threaten multiversal peace
planescape.rule.recording-and-reliving-s.mind: Can reproduce sensations, thoughts and emotions

planescape.rule.spell-scroll-tattoos-bur.name: Spell-scroll tattoos burn away when used

effect.summary: Tattoo designs that work as spell scrolls disappear after use and can singe the wearer.

planescape.rule.spell-scroll-tattoos-bur.go_wrong: Use may singe hair, fur or scales
planescape.rule.spell-scroll-tattoos-bur.combines: A tattoo may function as a spell scroll
planescape.rule.spell-scroll-tattoos-bur.blocked_reason: The passage states a power-bearing tattoo is consumed on use, a storage and depletion feature outside the basic grammar.

planescape.rule.mushroom-meld-telepathy.name: Mushroom Meld telepathy

effect.summary: Eaters within 30 feet of one another can communicate telepathically for one hour.

planescape.rule.mushroom-meld-telepathy.cost_or_limit: Requires eating the sandwich; 30-foot range and one-hour duration
planescape.rule.mushroom-meld-telepathy.who_may: Those who eat the Mushroom Meld

planescape.rule.living-things-transforme.name: Living things transformed into portals

effect.summary: Ignus's punishment made him a living portal linking the bar to the Elemental Plane of Fire.

planescape.rule.living-things-transforme.go_wrong: The transformation leaves the subject imprisoned in flame
planescape.rule.living-things-transforme.mind: Ignus remains a mage who can be roused
planescape.rule.living-things-transforme.where_from: A punishment imposed for his crimes
planescape.rule.living-things-transforme.combines: Portal connects to the Elemental Plane of Fire
planescape.rule.living-things-transforme.blocked_reason: A living creature becomes a planar portal, a body transformation not expressible by the basic effect grammar.

planescape.rule.portal-travelers-are-des.name: Portal travelers are destroyed and replaced with clones

effect.summary: Sigil natives believe portal travelers are replaced by clones.

planescape.rule.portal-travelers-are-des.cost_or_limit: Presented as a faction belief, not confirmed fact.
planescape.rule.portal-travelers-are-des.blocked_reason: The passage describes this as a belief, not an established world mechanism.

planescape.rule.arcane-blackouts.name: Arcane blackouts

effect.summary: Blackouts suppress magic-item effects, make spells unpredictable, and stop portals working.

planescape.rule.arcane-blackouts.cost_or_limit: Occur as sweeping events across Sigil.
planescape.rule.arcane-blackouts.go_wrong: Magic and portal operation are disrupted.
planescape.rule.arcane-blackouts.combines: Affects magic items, spells, and portals.
planescape.rule.arcane-blackouts.blocked_reason: The passage gives no operational rules for the citywide field or its unpredictable spell effects.

planescape.rule.cosmic-realignment.name: Cosmic Realignment

effect.summary: A location that too closely embodies an Outer Plane is absorbed with its inhabitants, expanding that plane and restoring Outlands balance.

planescape.rule.cosmic-realignment.cost_or_limit: Does not apply to the domains of gods.
planescape.rule.cosmic-realignment.go_wrong: The affected location and inhabitants leave the Outlands.
planescape.rule.cosmic-realignment.mind: Some beings resist by opposing the linked plane; others welcome or pursue absorption.
planescape.rule.cosmic-realignment.who_may: Outlands locations embodying an Outer Plane too strongly
planescape.rule.cosmic-realignment.combines: A linked Outer Plane absorbs the place and its inhabitants.
planescape.rule.cosmic-realignment.blocked_reason: The rule transfers a region and its inhabitants between planes without specifying area or transfer mechanics.

planescape.rule.outlands-day-and-night-c.name: Outlands day and night cycles

effect.summary: The plane has day and night periods called peak and antipeak, with night arriving about twelve hours after morning brightens.

planescape.rule.outlands-day-and-night-c.cost_or_limit: No apparent suns, moons, or stars mark the cycles.
planescape.rule.outlands-day-and-night-c.blocked_reason: The cycle is a straightforward timed environmental rule.

planescape.rule.spireward-and-brinkward.name: spireward and brinkward

effect.summary: Travelers orient themselves toward the Spire as spireward; the opposite direction is brinkward.

planescape.rule.spireward-and-brinkward.combines: Orientation uses the Spire rather than visible celestial bodies.

planescape.rule.it-takes-as-long-as-it-t.name: It takes as long as it takes

effect.summary: Outlands travel distances are hard to judge and travel durations can vary from minutes to days.

planescape.rule.it-takes-as-long-as-it-t.cost_or_limit: The DM determines travel time; distance fluctuates.
planescape.rule.it-takes-as-long-as-it-t.combines: Travel time and apparent distance fluctuate together.
planescape.rule.it-takes-as-long-as-it-t.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as variable travel time.

planescape.rule.great-modron-march.name: Great Modron March

effect.summary: Every 289 years, thousands of modrons travel from Automata through the gate-towns and Outer Planes.

planescape.rule.great-modron-march.cost_or_limit: Normally coincides with every seventeenth Grand Cycle, but has occurred early.
planescape.rule.great-modron-march.go_wrong: An early march caused widespread havoc as modrons trampled through the planes.
planescape.rule.great-modron-march.combines: May collect data or calibrate the multiverse, according to theories.

planescape.rule.automata-regional-effect.name: Automata regional effects

effect.summary: Repeated sounds synchronize to the gate’s beat, and the town’s buildings and natural forms are symmetrical under temperate weather.

planescape.rule.automata-regional-effect.cost_or_limit: Applies in and around Automata’s gate-town.
planescape.rule.automata-regional-effect.combines: The gate ticks in time with Mechanus’s gears.
planescape.rule.automata-regional-effect.blocked_reason: The effects apply continuously across a region and combine sound synchronization with environmental alteration.

planescape.rule.hall-of-disorder-sentenc.name: Hall of Disorder sentencing

effect.summary: The council imposes lighter penalties when the defense is more illogical.

planescape.rule.hall-of-disorder-sentenc.go_wrong: The process rewards absurd argument rather than sound defense.
planescape.rule.hall-of-disorder-sentenc.combines: Judgment depends on the accused’s defense.

planescape.rule.bedlam-s-gate-winds.name: Bedlam’s gate winds

effect.summary: The gate emits powerful winds; sealing it can reverse their direction, engulfing the sealer before they resume outward flow.

planescape.rule.bedlam-s-gate-winds.cost_or_limit: Winds continue despite an attempted magical seal.
planescape.rule.bedlam-s-gate-winds.go_wrong: A sealer may be engulfed by the reversed gusts.
planescape.rule.bedlam-s-gate-winds.mind: The winds can encourage dark deeds.
planescape.rule.bedlam-s-gate-winds.combines: Interacts with attempts to seal the gate and with Cirrus’s emergence.
planescape.rule.bedlam-s-gate-winds.blocked_reason: The passage does not specify how sealing the portal produces the reversal or its consequences.

planescape.rule.bedlam-regional-effects.name: Bedlam regional effects

effect.summary: Winds deafen creatures within 1,000 feet of the gate and can dominate residents into evil acts.

planescape.rule.bedlam-regional-effects.cost_or_limit: The effects apply around Bedlam’s planar gate; domination occurs occasionally.
planescape.rule.bedlam-regional-effects.go_wrong: Residents may be compelled to commit evil deeds.
planescape.rule.bedlam-regional-effects.mind: The winds can dominate and compel townsfolk.
planescape.rule.bedlam-regional-effects.who_may: Creatures near the gate and Bedlam residents
planescape.rule.bedlam-regional-effects.combines: The town’s winds carry the effects.
planescape.rule.bedlam-regional-effects.blocked_reason: The regional effects include broad-area deafening and mental domination, which the basic grammar cannot fully model.

planescape.rule.second-exile.name: Second Exile

effect.summary: An offender is bound and thrown through Curst’s gate, never to return.

planescape.rule.second-exile.cost_or_limit: Reserved for especially grave crimes; the burgomaster alone decides the sentence.
planescape.rule.second-exile.go_wrong: The offender is exiled through the portal and does not return.
planescape.rule.second-exile.who_may: The burgomaster imposes it on offenders.

planescape.rule.curst-regional-effects.name: Curst regional effects

effect.summary: Residents feel burdened and lose five feet of speed; non-gate teleportation and planar escape attempts fail.

planescape.rule.curst-regional-effects.cost_or_limit: The burgomaster can suppress either effect for chosen creatures for one hour.
planescape.rule.curst-regional-effects.go_wrong: Attempts to escape through excluded means are wasted.
planescape.rule.curst-regional-effects.mind: Residents feel as if dragging a ball and chain.
planescape.rule.curst-regional-effects.combines: The burgomaster can suppress either effect as an action.
planescape.rule.curst-regional-effects.mechanism: regional movement restriction and teleport blocking
planescape.rule.curst-regional-effects.blocked_reason: The effects apply to creatures throughout a region and include a broad restriction on spatial transport.

planescape.rule.do-no-evil.name: Do no evil

effect.summary: Ecstasy’s monarchs prohibit evil conduct in the town.

planescape.rule.do-no-evil.cost_or_limit: The rule’s application is complicated by spirits who encourage boundary-pushing.
planescape.rule.do-no-evil.mind: The town suppresses negativity without removing it.
planescape.rule.do-no-evil.who_may: Ecstasy’s inhabitants under the monarchs’ authority
planescape.rule.do-no-evil.combines: Enforced by the Lightcaller and Nightwhisperer.
planescape.rule.do-no-evil.blocked_reason: The passage describes suppressed emotions accumulating and erupting, a drift effect not captured by the basic grammar.

planescape.rule.ecstasy-regional-effects.name: Ecstasy regional effects

effect.summary: Residents are friendly to nonhostile visitors, and creatures have advantage against becoming or remaining frightened.

planescape.rule.ecstasy-regional-effects.go_wrong: The town suppresses rather than removes negativity.
planescape.rule.ecstasy-regional-effects.mind: Promotes friendliness and resilience against fear.
planescape.rule.ecstasy-regional-effects.combines: Works alongside the Bone Plinth’s calming aura.
planescape.rule.ecstasy-regional-effects.blocked_reason: The effects are persistent region-wide modifiers.

planescape.rule.excelsior-gate-recogniti.name: Excelsior gate recognition

effect.summary: Celestials and those with pure hearts or intentions can hear the heavenly portal’s distant choir.

planescape.rule.excelsior-gate-recogniti.cost_or_limit: Access is difficult; the gate is reached by a single path.
planescape.rule.excelsior-gate-recogniti.go_wrong: Intruders may be disoriented by the tower’s shifting interior.
planescape.rule.excelsior-gate-recogniti.mind: Purity of heart or intent determines perception.
planescape.rule.excelsior-gate-recogniti.who_may: Celestials and those with pure hearts or intentions
planescape.rule.excelsior-gate-recogniti.combines: The gate’s sound helps eligible travelers locate it.
planescape.rule.excelsior-gate-recogniti.blocked_reason: The passage gives a supernatural detection effect keyed to a creature’s nature or intentions.

planescape.rule.excelsior-regional-effec.name: Excelsior regional effects

effect.summary: Streets and temples glow warmly, goodness is reflected in perfect surroundings, and clouds become solid and support buildings.

planescape.rule.excelsior-regional-effec.cost_or_limit: The cloud structures are controlled magically by their owners.
planescape.rule.excelsior-regional-effec.go_wrong: Evil creatures find the light repulsive.
planescape.rule.excelsior-regional-effec.combines: Clouds support buildings, keeps, and mansions.
planescape.rule.excelsior-regional-effec.blocked_reason: The effects transform and sustain an entire region’s light, climate, produce, and clouds.

planescape.rule.faunel-regional-effects.name: Faunel regional effects

effect.summary: Beasts are more intelligent and may speak Common; frequent rain makes foraging easier and fruit and water abundant.

planescape.rule.faunel-regional-effects.cost_or_limit: Beast Intelligence 10 and speech are at the DM’s discretion; Survival foraging checks have advantage.
planescape.rule.faunel-regional-effects.mind: Increases animal intelligence and language ability.
planescape.rule.faunel-regional-effects.combines: The gate pool also awakens beasts and nourishes wooden guardians.
planescape.rule.faunel-regional-effects.blocked_reason: The effects apply across a region, alter creature minds, and change resource availability.

planescape.rule.feast-on-the-toppled-sto.name: Feast on the toppled stone

effect.summary: Travelers who eat the appearing feasts are never seen again.

planescape.rule.feast-on-the-toppled-sto.cost_or_limit: Partaking in the feast leads to disappearance.
planescape.rule.feast-on-the-toppled-sto.where_from: The lifeless toppled stone in the forest.
planescape.rule.feast-on-the-toppled-sto.blocked_reason: The passage gives no mechanism or destination for the disappearance.

planescape.rule.torch-s-doubled-expenses.name: Torch's doubled expenses

effect.summary: Equipment and lifestyle expenses in Torch are twice their usual amount.

planescape.rule.torch-s-doubled-expenses.where_from: Gehenna's influence around Torch's planar gate.
planescape.rule.torch-s-doubled-expenses.blocked_reason: A basic cost modifier can represent this rule.

planescape.rule.whispering-valuables.name: Whispering valuables

effect.summary: Visible valuables whisper faintly to nearby creatures, growing louder with their value.

planescape.rule.whispering-valuables.cost_or_limit: Only visible coinage, jewelry, and magic items are affected.
planescape.rule.whispering-valuables.go_wrong: The whispers may entice nearby creatures.
planescape.rule.whispering-valuables.mind: The whispers are unintelligible and may tempt creatures.
planescape.rule.whispering-valuables.where_from: Gehenna's influence around Torch's planar gate.
planescape.rule.whispering-valuables.combines: Volume rises with an item's value.
planescape.rule.whispering-valuables.blocked_reason: The passage does not define what the whispers do beyond enticing nearby creatures.

planescape.rule.tradegate-crafting-reduc.name: Tradegate crafting reduction

effect.summary: Crafting nonmagical objects in Tradegate takes half the normal time and cost.

planescape.rule.tradegate-crafting-reduc.where_from: Bytopia's influence around Tradegate's planar gate.
planescape.rule.tradegate-crafting-reduc.combines: Halves both crafting time and expense.
planescape.rule.tradegate-crafting-reduc.blocked_reason: Basic cost and time adjustments can represent this rule.

planescape.rule.tradegate-repairs.name: Tradegate repairs

effect.summary: The populace repairs damaged buildings, roads, and structures within 1d10 days.

planescape.rule.tradegate-repairs.where_from: Bytopia's influence around Tradegate's planar gate.
planescape.rule.tradegate-repairs.combines: Applies to damaged buildings, roads, and structures.
planescape.rule.tradegate-repairs.blocked_reason: A delayed repair can be represented by a scheduled restoration.

planescape.rule.limbo-damage-substitutio.name: Limbo damage substitution

effect.summary: A spell's acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage may be replaced by another of those types, rolled on a d4.

planescape.rule.limbo-damage-substitutio.cost_or_limit: At most one damage type changes per spell casting.
planescape.rule.limbo-damage-substitutio.go_wrong: The result may leave the type unchanged.
planescape.rule.limbo-damage-substitutio.who_may: A creature in Xaos casting a spell with one of the listed damage types.
planescape.rule.limbo-damage-substitutio.where_from: Limbo's influence around Xaos's planar gate.
planescape.rule.limbo-damage-substitutio.combines: Roll a d4 to select acid, cold, fire, or lightning.
planescape.rule.limbo-damage-substitutio.blocked_reason: A single damage-type alteration can be represented by the basic effect grammar.

planescape.rule.xaos-structures-dissolve.name: Xaos structures dissolve and reform

effect.summary: Structures in Xaos randomly dissolve and reform into different structures without harming inhabitants.

planescape.rule.xaos-structures-dissolve.cost_or_limit: The change is random; inhabitants are unharmed.
planescape.rule.xaos-structures-dissolve.go_wrong: Buildings may become hazardous forms, including structures emitting poison gas.
planescape.rule.xaos-structures-dissolve.where_from: Limbo's influence around Xaos's planar gate.
planescape.rule.xaos-structures-dissolve.combines: Structures transform into other materials and buildings.
planescape.rule.xaos-structures-dissolve.blocked_reason: The passage describes uncontrolled transformations with varied outcomes beyond a defined basic effect.
